author: IGN
description:
The Relic: First Guardian review by Jarrett Green on PC.

The true dark fantasy of The Relic: First Guardian is all of the potential it squanders. It is the bones of something that could have grown to be a notable action game, especially in its energetic combat. But everything about this experience, including its combat, is marred in some way by its own shambolic state. The janky subtitles and sometimes straight-up terrible visual quality could be tolerated, but The Relic is fundamentally broken in too many inexcusable ways. It’s a gem that's barely cut, let alone polished.

#TheRelicFirstGuardian #TheRelic #Soulslike
title: The Relic: First Guardian Review

author: IGN
description:
Grand Theft Auto legacy review by Luke Reilly. Reviewed on PC and PlayStation.

"Like a Stone Age axe, Grand Theft Auto is hard, primitive, and – honestly – more than a little cumbersome. However, like said axe, it’s nonetheless a valuable artefact that maintains an effective edge to it. Fearless but flawed and endearing but unnecessarily difficult, the original Grand Theft Auto may be tricky to wholeheartedly recommend to anyone who didn’t previously play it during its moment back in the late ’90s, but I can’t deny how fascinating it’s been to re-experience its prehistoric brand of open-world freedom in the context of everything that’s come since. It just demands patience, precision, and a paper map by your side."
title: Grand Theft Auto – The Legacy Review
